ids: engine-paint report-2 notDone: rug tone under the sofa after Remove + rug Customize
done.what: Sofa Remove + rug Customize in one Generate: the laid rug by the table's leg now reads as the shaded rug beside the throw. Navy is L15 against L14 (was L19 against L14), and the plain rug is the same. Four changes in engine/mend weaveFill. (1) The rug's colour is its ONE colour as it reads beside the hidden part: the middle of the rug that shows within ~100 px, with a standing piece's traced shade left out. Before, a colour per row was read off the rug's clear far end, which laid the shade by the throw as a slanted band and made the laid rug lighter. (2) The light it lies in is read beside it close up (over a few ribs) and carried into the laid part the way light falls in the picture: wide, short reaches, nearest weighted most, fading over ~150 px. At the join the laid rug is the rug beside it. (3) The table's shade step now reaches down as far as its shadow lies on the rug beside the throw, in the shadow's warm colour (`tint`), softened over everything laid (`soft`, `shadeReach`: the rug woven under it too). (4) Weave blocks are evened out (their own brightness taken out) and are never cut from a shade (`source_` stays out of a standing piece's shade and the band the sofa threw). A standing piece's shade at the join stays the photo's own (the table's). The lighter slab at the laid rug's front-left is gone too.

ids: final-engine new issue 0: Remove the fig erases the TV console's cast shadow
done.what: The console now has a traced `casts` (its shade on the wall right of its end, from the speaker's corner down, fading out before the fig's pot). In lift, a kept piece's traced shade stays wherever it isn't under the lifted piece itself, and its edge fades into the plate (~16 px). Taken out itself, the console still takes its shade with it. Fig Remove: the wall right of the console reads L36 against the photo's L36 (was L63, flat).

ids: final-engine new issue 2: after a sofa Remove the rebuilt coffee-table top's front edge is a pale, stair-stepped strip
done.what: The table's `along` step now reads off all of the table that shows along its front line (`wide`: the lip left of where the throw hung), not only its traced area, which had nothing showing, so the plate's pale floor stayed. The area's lower edge now follows the lip. The top reads as oak with one straight lip; the stair-steps are gone at 2x.

ids: final-engine polish: tan rim on the throw's corner after the coffee table Remove
done.what: Where a piece in front borders the lifted piece, a rim pixel (2 px deep) goes with the lifted piece if its colour reads nearer the lifted piece close by than the front piece (`rimOf` in run.ts). That is the throw's corner blended with the table's oak. A rim that reads as itself stays (the console top under the TV). The tan rim round the throw's corner is gone at 12x.
